title: Mixed-priority batch creation
description: Probes whether the agent correctly varies a per-item field (priority) within a single batch creation request, rather than collapsing everything to one value or issuing one call per task. RE-VERIFIED 2026-07-25 (netadvanced/vikunja-mcp#28 C1): optimalCallCount reasoning unchanged -- create-project (1) + bulk-create 6 tasks with per-task `priority` values in the same call (1) = 2. Neither PR #178 (label taskIds) nor PR #175 (setup-kanban) changes this: there is no label or Kanban dimension to this ask, and setup-kanban would only save the same 1 call at the cost of fabricating an unrequested Kanban board -- deliberately not credited here (see docs/BATTLE-TESTING.md's re-baselining policy) since it would erode this scenario's own signal (does the agent vary a per-item field within ONE bulk-create, not just any single call).
promptTemplate: Create a project called "{{prefix}}Feature Backlog" with 6 tasks: two low priority (priority 1) called "{{prefix}}low-N", two medium priority (priority 3) called "{{prefix}}med-N", and two high priority (priority 5) called "{{prefix}}high-N" (N=1..2 within each group).
